notes.claim: In a closed system, total momentum before an event equals total momentum after it.
A closed system is one not affected by external forces.
Momentum is mass times velocity, and it is a vector, so direction matters as well as size.
In an inelastic collision momentum is still conserved but kinetic energy is not.
